turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning. I am calling from Fieldgate Surgery on behalf of a patient, Margaret Ellery, date of birth the seventeenth of March 1941. She would like to be seen again.

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Right, bear with me. What is it regarding?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: She asked me to pass on her own words: I can't get up the stairs the way I could a fortnight ago.

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Was that the nurse she saw, or the doctor?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm only able to pass on what she said. The practice has the rest on file.

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: I could do Thursday at ten past nine, face to face. Would that suit her?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thursday at ten past nine, face to face. Yes, she will take that. Thank you.

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: That's down for her. Anything else?
